Events and opportunities
Broaden your knowledge with training courses, seminars and lectures of an interdisciplinary nature, covering topics related both to the academic world and to the world of work and career development. Meet fellow colleagues at events dedicated to those undertaking a PhD and become part of one of our most important university associations: you will be able to share different experiences, skills and professional expertise.
